scientific_integrity: The analytic finite-graph proof is accompanied by a standalone exact-enumeration verifier. No numerical sampling substitutes for the unrestricted field inequalities.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the specified twelve-vertex three-state Potts antiferromagnet, equal positive edge penalties, uniform field H>0, and zero-temperature ground states. No finite-temperature singularity, universality or smallest possible counterexample is claimed. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp field-induced sitewise colour inversion on the Frucht Potts antiferromagnet
